findings: Initial and final six-view geometry sheets inspected. Generic typewriter approximately 33 cm wide including knobs, 27 cm deep and 15 cm high without paper. Four feet support chassis; three key banks connect through stems; carriage supports transverse platen with two knobs, connected return lever, bail and two paper rollers. Paper reaches roller tangent.

Chassis winding and paper contact were corrected in the authoritative scene before the initial inspected sheet. Final key facet simplification and paint retain support points and occlusion. Internal mechanical linkages omitted; no full mechanism simulation claimed.

Four original flat symbols represent rehearsal script, election-volunteer training checklist, Forum Theatre facilitation and campus doorway/map marker. No anatomy or complex volumes used in these four.
Five native-size cards, nine accepted custom/Noto reference cards and ten final IconManager variants inspected. Four flat source hashes unchanged after typewriter optimization.

Museum dimensions and construction are text-only references. Local museum capture was blocked and manual diagrams were not inspected. Generic proportions are approximate, not a model-specific reconstruction.
